headline: UK ICO reports developer privacy commitments and opens an agentic-AI evidence call
summary: On 8 October 2026, the UK Information Commissioner's Office said ten major foundation-model developers operating in the UK had made or committed to changes covering transparency, people's ability to exercise their data rights, and safeguards. The ICO also opened a six-week call for evidence on data-protection risks of agentic AI, closing 20 November, and said enquiries into OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and the UK AI Security Institute concerning earlier testing and deployment were ongoing. The notice does not identify each developer's completed actions, report investigation findings or demonstrate that the changes reduced risk.
